description: This file is a Perl test script for the `_collapse_dotdot` utility function from the `Git::SVN::Utils` module. It contains test cases to verify the correct behavior of the function which presumably simplifies file path strings by resolving dot-dot `..` and dot `.` components.

methods.name: _collapse_dotdot
methods.description: A private utility function from the `Git::SVN::Utils` module used to normalize file path strings by collapsing `..` and `.` components.
